name: ASPCA
summary: The American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals, the oldest US animal welfare charity: an animal hospital, adoption centre and low-cost clinics in New York, Miami and Los Angeles, the Spay/Neuter Alliance, relocation of animals from crowded shelters, Animal Poison Control, disaster and cruelty response, grants to shelters, national adoption campaigns, and policy work on puppy mills, horses and farm animals.

spending.source: https://www.aspca.org/sites/default/files/2025-aspca-final-issued-audited-financials.pdf (consolidated statement of activities p. 7: total program expenses $315,816,482 of total operating expenses $421,778,136, year to 31 December 2025; excludes membership development and fundraising $85,739,823 and management $20,221,831.)

lines.label: Shelters, veterinary care, neutering, poison control, disaster and cruelty response, grants, education and policy for dogs, cats and horses
lines.source: https://www.aspca.org/sites/default/files/2025-aspca-final-issued-audited-financials.pdf (p. 7): shelter and veterinary services $158,321,895, public education and communications $89,973,675 less its farm-animal share (facts/aspca.json farm_share_of_pec, our judgment of 3%) and policy, response and engagement $67,520,912 less its farm-animal share (farm_share_of_pre, our judgment of 8%), year to 31 December 2025. One line because charityevals models these activities as branches of one companion-animals model.

lines.label: Farm animal welfare (defending state cage and crate laws, higher-welfare market work)
lines.source: https://www.aspca.org/sites/default/files/2025-aspca-final-issued-audited-financials.pdf (p. 7): 8% of policy, response and engagement $67,520,912 plus 3% of public education and communications $89,973,675 (facts/aspca.json, our judgments; the accounts don't split the lines by department), year to 31 December 2025.
